the mechanics of the dependency bumps look good, but I honestly don't know how to review the reflect2 changes for correctness... that's pretty concerning to me

Reflect2 is fast but a risky dependency in general. Example for go 1.18:
https://github.com/modern-go/reflect2/releases/tag/v1.0.2

Looks like k8s already has a version of reflect2 that would fail on gccgo.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/623f9f36e00675bdf59207290f25f29cc1d24f30/go.mod#L349

The build tags are just a stop gap.

Overall I am +1 to not depend on reflect2, but i am assuming that is going
to be difficult at this point.

I'm still _very_ uneasy about this dependency (hence the attempts to remove use of it in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105030), but after review, it appears this update does not make the state of the dependency worse

#### Which jobs are failing:

Kubernetes tests and some of the components using `github.com/json-iterator/go` are failing with golang tip because the [issue](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/48238#issuecomment-917321536) reported and got fixed in the [json-iterator v1.1.12 release](https://github.com/json-iterator/go/releases/tag/v1.1.12)

Sample test report can be found here - https://prow.ppc64le-cloud.org/view/s3/prow-logs/logs/postsubmit-master-golang-kubernetes-unit-test-ppc64le/1437101281280790528

#### Since when has it been failing:

#### Testgrid link:

#### Reason for failure:
https://github.com/modern-go/reflect2/issues/24
https://github.com/golang/go/issues/48238

#### Anything else we need to know:


Bumping github.com/json-iterator/go to v1.1.12 in the following repositories will help to fix the issue mentioned here

https://cs.k8s.io/?q=json-iterator%2Fgo&i=nope&files=go.mod&excludeFiles=vendor&repos=kubernetes/kubernetes

- [ ] kubernetes/kubernetes

This got merged via https://github.com/modern-go/reflect2/pull/10 to avoid building it on gccgo, and I'm not sure if anyone is really still using gccgo version, I remember we(ppc64le) were using gccgo during the initial days but not anymore.
are all of these updated fields correct/compatible with versions of go prior to 1.18?
this is the only remaining question I have
verified the runtime.hiter struct did not change members between go1.17 and master
this doesn't match the args or return type of this function in go1.17 - https://github.com/golang/go/blob/go1.17/src/reflect/value.go#L3172 ... is that problematic?
yes, that's this line, but it doesn't match the go1.17 signature

Traced [this](https://github.com/modern-go/reflect2-tests/blob/dc6d131807a13a75102b655383e4c60c1b76449e/tests/map_test.go#L91) unit test case in reflect2 with go 1.17 and found that the linking is done [here](https://github.com/golang/go/blob/ec5170397c724a8ae440b2bc529f857c86f0e6b1/src/runtime/map.go#L1337) and the test run was successfull
there are no uses of this in json-iterator or any vendored kubernetes code
